# POMPEII: THE CITY THAT DISAPPEARED IN ONE DAY
*The Final Hours of an Ancient Roman City* · a Buried Chronicles documentary

A 7:19, 16:9 (1920x1080, 30 fps) 2D animated documentary rendered entirely from code. It covers 12 chapters in 72 shots, with a male narrator, a synthesized score and sound design, animated maps, scientific diagrams, archival inserts and subtitles.

**Rendered output** (not committed; it is regenerated by the pipeline): `out/pompeii/final.mp4`

## Painted cut (v2, Globexplained style)
`index_v2.html` / `film_v2.js` / `shots_v2.js`: the same narration, timing, score and graphics, with every scene an AI-painted plate (59 paintings from `v2/plates.json`, DreamShaper 8 LCM run locally) animated with slow camera moves, ash, smoke, embers and light. Render: `node pompeii/tools/render_fast.mjs --page index_v2.html --out out/pompeii/video_v2.mp4`, after `python3 pompeii/tools/upscale_plates.py`.

## Layout
```
film.js, index.html, film.json   the film (window.seek(t) paints frame t)
shots.js                          the shot list / edit decision list, anchored to narration lines
sets/                             street, forum, atrium, aerial, map, diagrams, views (painted worlds)
lib/                              motion (harness), cam3d, paint, figures, fx, gfx (graphics kit), util
audio/                            script.json, build_vo.py, sound.py, vo/takes, vo.wav, music.wav, sfx.wav, mix.wav
timeline.json, cues.json          narration clock (with word timings) and the exported cue sheet
assets/                           archival illustrations (public domain), Natural Earth land data
deliverables/                     subtitles, chapters, VO script, character sheets, thumbnails
tools/                            render_fast.mjs, make_subs.py, make_docs.py, export_shots.mjs, shoot_*.mjs
```
Rebuild steps: [docs/K](docs/K_editing_export.md).
